description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a portable markdown memory store with a soul.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆：可迁移的 markdown 记忆库，还带一份灵魂。

description.en: Cross-session markdown memory with SOUL persona, session switch, quick soul setup, 3D memory graph (search / reveal / double-click opens the file in the sidebar), boot snapshot, health dashboard and portable pack/unpack.
description.zh: 跨会话 markdown 记忆：SOUL 人格、会话级开关、快速铸魂、3D 记忆图谱（搜索/打开文件/双击在侧栏打开）、boot 快照、健康看板与 pack/unpack 迁移。
